S45.01.needs: an image file on the Mac and an account that can use image generation
S45.01.note: The + button's own label was not confirmed; the tester should look for the plus icon at the left of the message box.
steps: Click + at the left of the message box and turn on Create image (image mode).
Click + again and click Add photos & files, then choose a picture from your Mac.
Check that the picture appears as an attachment above the message box.
Type a change in the message box and press send.
Look that the result is an edit of your picture (the uploaded picture is the first attachment, and the composer shows the Edit option in the Attached image action menu).
S45.01.where: Composer (message box) > + button > Add photos & files, then pick a picture. Turn on image mode with + > Create image first.

S45.02.needs: an image generated earlier, in this chat or an older one
S45.02.note: The Library entry in the sidebar was not confirmed; the Library page header text was found.
steps: Open a chat with a generated image, or open Library from the sidebar.
In chat, move the pointer over the image and click New version.
In Library, click the Actions for the image's file name button and click Remix.
Check that the Revise this image panel opens with the image and its original prompt (or that the composer is in image mode with the image attached).
S45.02.where: A generated image in chat > hover it and click New version. From the Library: Library > Actions for <image name> > Remix.

labels.text: Describe a change to this image...
Apply this change to the image

S45.03.needs: a generated image in a chat
steps: Hover a generated image in chat and click New version.
Click in the box that says Describe a change to this image...
Type a change such as make the sky red.
Click the send button labelled Apply this change to the image (or press Enter).
Look that the image above is edited to match the change, and that a new version is added.
S45.03.where: Generated image > New version > type in the box Describe a change to this image... > click Apply this change to the image.

S45.05.needs: a generated image in a chat and a model that supports editing
S45.05.note: The tester should expect the edit to be only as precise as the model allows; the code's own hint says nearby content may change too.
steps: Hover a generated image and click New version.
Click Select area in the Revise this image panel.
Drag the mouse over the part of the image to change.
Click Apply this change to the image after typing a change, or look at the painted area before applying.
Look that only the painted area is changed (the composer hint says nearby content may change too).
S45.05.where: Generated image > New version > Select area, then paint over the part of the image to change.

S45.10.needs: a generated image in a chat and a model that supports editing
S45.10.note: The Clear selection button only appears after something is painted; a mask file attached with Add mask is removed with the Remove mask button instead.
steps: Open New version on a generated image and click Select area.
Paint over an area of the image with the mouse.
Look for the Clear selection button that appears next to Cancel selection.
Click Clear selection.
Look that the painted area disappears in one click and the Clear selection button goes away.
S45.10.where: Revise this image panel > Select area > paint something > Clear selection.

S45.15.needs: an image file on the Mac and an account that can use image generation
S45.15.note: The Transparent button shows only when the selected image model supports editing, and its hover text is Return the image on a transparent background.
steps: Click + and turn on Create image.
Attach a picture with + > Add photos & files.
Click the Transparent button in the row under the message box so it is highlighted.
Type a prompt such as remove the background and send.
Look that the result shows the subject on a transparent background (checker pattern or transparent in Preview).
S45.15.where: Composer > Create image (image mode) > attach a picture > click Transparent > type a prompt > send.

S45.16.needs: a generated image in a chat and a model that supports editing
S45.16.note: Outpainting is reached only through the Aspect ratio menu; the composer's Attached image action menu does not offer it, as its code comment says.
steps: Hover a generated image and click New version.
Click the Aspect ratio button at the top of the Revise this image panel.
Choose a wider option such as 16:9.
Wait for the new version to generate.
Look that the picture is larger and the new side areas match the original scene.
S45.16.where: Generated image > New version > Aspect ratio > choose a wider ratio.

labels.text: Generate this image with a different aspect ratio

S45.19.needs: a generated image in a chat and a model that supports editing
S45.19.note: If the chosen ratio equals the current one, nothing is generated.
steps: Hover a generated image and click New version.
Click the Aspect ratio button (its hover text is Generate this image with a different aspect ratio).
Choose a different ratio such as 1:1 or 9:16.
Wait for the new version.
Look that the same scene is reframed to the new shape rather than a new unrelated picture.
S45.19.where: Generated image > New version > Aspect ratio > choose a different ratio.

S45.22.needs: two image files on the Mac and an account that can use image generation
S45.22.note: The composer has no label that says reference image for pictures; the limit notice says the first is edited and the others guide it, and the reference route is shown only through the attachment order.
steps: Turn on Create image from the + menu.
Attach the source picture with + > Add photos & files.
Attach a second picture the same way.
Type a prompt that asks for the subject or layout of the second picture, and send.
Look that the result uses the subject, layout or style of the reference picture.
S45.22.where: Composer > + > Create image (image mode) > + > Add photos & files for a second picture (the first picture is edited, the others guide it).

S45.31.needs: a generated image that has been edited at least once
steps: Hover a generated image and click New version, then close the panel.
Look for the Image versions group under the image with the counter, for example 1 / 2.
Click Previous version to see the original.
Check that the original image still exists next to the new version.
S45.31.where: Generated image > New version > the Image versions arrows (Previous version / Next version) under the image.

S45.33.needs: a transparent PNG file on the Mac and an account that can use image generation
S45.33.note: Whether alpha survives editing and storage is not proven by the code audit; the steps only make it visible.
steps: Turn on Create image and attach a transparent PNG with + > Add photos & files.
Click Transparent so it is highlighted, type a prompt and send.
Click the Download button on the result image card.
Open the downloaded file in Preview and look for a transparent background (checker pattern).
S45.33.where: Composer > Create image > Transparent on, attach a transparent PNG, send; then the Download button on the result.
